IDBI Bank employees began a two-day nationwide strike on Monday to protest against the proposed privatisation of the lender, demanding that the Union government scrap the sale to Canada’s Fairfax Financial Holdings.
More than 10,000 employees across over 2,000 branches are expected to participate in the strike on November 2 and 3.
The strike comes weeks after the government approved the sale of a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank to Fairfax, led by Canadian billionaire Prem Watsa, for about ₹53,000 crore.
